unit_definition: One synthetic independent study, containing all prespecified panel cohorts
cohort_selection_rule: Exactly one cohort on P1 and one on P2 in every calibration and target study; no selection by scores
roster_provenance: Small hand-written teaching roster, with three calibration studies and one target study; not empirical evidence
counts_provenance: Synthetic complete histograms generated for arithmetic and workflow checks; not empirical evidence

panel_provenance.P1: Explicit synthetic grid <=1, 2, >2 mg/L, with recorded values 1, 2, 4 mg/L
panel_provenance.P2: Explicit synthetic grid <=2, 4, >4 mg/L, with recorded values 2, 4, 8 mg/L
